name: 1-step wax - n - dry
specs: ABRO 1-Step Wax-N-Dry (WD-473) is a premium car wax designed for application directly onto wet vehicle surfaces. It combines advanced water-reactive polymers with high-grade carnauba wax to dry and wax in a single step, leaving a brilliant, streak-free gloss.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash the vehicle thoroughly. 2. While the vehicle is still wet, spray the product lightly onto one section at a time. 3. Spread and dry the product using a microfiber towel or chamois, turning it frequently to achieve a high-gloss, protective finish.

name: A/c deodorizer lemon scent
specs: ABRO A/C Deodorizer Lemon Scent (AC-050) is a fast-acting aerosol designed to eliminate odors, mold, and bacteria from automotive air conditioning systems. It sanitizes the ductwork and leaves behind a clean, refreshing lemon fragrance.
usageInstructions: 1. Start the engine and set the air conditioner to maximum recirculation, high fan, and lowest temperature. 2. Shake the can well and spray into the external air intake vents or position the can on the floor of the vehicle, activating the continuous release valve. 3. Keep doors and windows closed for 10-15 minutes, then ventilate the car thoroughly before driving.

name: AB80 Spray Lubricant - 210ml
specs: AB-80 Spray Lubricant 210ml is a multi-purpose penetrant, lubricant, rust preventative, and moisture displacer. It stops squeaks, frees sticky mechanisms, and protects metal surfaces from corrosion.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well before use. 2. Spray directly onto the rusted or sticky part using the extension straw for hard-to-reach areas. 3. Allow a few minutes for the formula to penetrate before attempting to loosen or move the part.

name: AB80 Spray Lubricant - 400ml
specs: AB-80 Spray Lubricant 400ml is a professional-grade, larger-format multi-purpose penetrant, lubricant, and anti-corrosion spray. Ideal for industrial, automotive, and household applications to displace moisture and free seized parts.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray onto the target area, saturating the surface. 3. For heavy rust, let the lubricant soak for several minutes, tapping the part lightly to accelerate penetration.

name: Abro steel - carded epoxy putty
specs: ABRO Steel Carded Epoxy Putty (AS-201) is a steel-reinforced, hand-mixable epoxy putty that cures in minutes. It can be used to plug, seal, and rebuild steel, iron, copper, brass, bronze, and many other materials.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry the repair surface, sanding it slightly for better adhesion. 2. Cut off the desired amount of putty. 3. Knead the putty with your fingers until a uniform gray color is achieved. 4. Press firmly into the crack or hole within 2 minutes of mixing. Smooth out with a damp tool if desired.

name: Abro steel adhesive tube
specs: ABRO Steel Adhesive Tube (AS-224) is a two-part, heavy-duty liquid epoxy adhesive designed for bonding metal, wood, concrete, and ceramic. It offers high tensile strength and chemical resistance once fully cured.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure both surfaces are completely clean, dry, and free of oil. 2. Squeeze equal parts of resin and hardener onto a clean, disposable surface. 3. Mix thoroughly for 1 minute. 4. Apply a thin layer to both surfaces, press them together immediately, and clamp or hold in place for 5-10 minutes.

name: Acrylic sealant 600 - black
specs: ABRO Acrylic Sealant 600 Black (AS-600-BLK) is a premium water-based acrylic gap filler that cures to form a flexible, paintable seal. It is perfect for perimeter sealing around windows, doors, baseboards, and low-movement joints.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the joint of all dust, dirt, and loose material. 2. Cut the cartridge nozzle at a 45-degree angle to the desired bead size and place it in a caulking gun. 3. Apply the sealant evenly into the joint. 4. Smooth the bead immediately using a wet spatula or finger, and allow at least 24 hours to cure before painting.

name: Acrylic sealant 600 - white
specs: ABRO Acrylic Sealant 600 White (AS-600-WHT) is a high-performance, white-colored acrylic sealant. It features excellent adhesion to concrete, wood, masonry, and plaster, providing a clean, paintable finish once fully cured.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the application surface is clean, dry, and structurally sound. 2. Insert the cartridge into a standard caulking gun and cut the tip. 3. Apply a continuous bead along the joint. 4. Tool the joint immediately to ensure solid contact with the sides, and clean up any excess with a damp cloth before it dries.

name: Air cleaner
specs: ABRO Air Cleaner (AC-100) is a specialized solvent spray formulated to quickly clean and maintain mass air flow sensors, air intake valves, and idle air control valves without leaving any residue.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the engine is cool and the ignition is turned off. 2. Remove the air filter and locate the air intake system. 3. Spray the product directly onto the dirty components, using short bursts. 4. Allow the product to evaporate completely and dry before reassembling and starting the engine.

name: Air fresheners assorted scents [1x60]
specs: ABRO Air Fresheners Assorted Scents (AF-835-AS) is a bulk pack of premium-quality, long-lasting hanging air fresheners. They are infused with high-grade fragrance oils designed to neutralize odors in cars, offices, and homes.
usageInstructions: 1. Remove the air freshener from its protective packaging. 2. Hang it freely on your rearview mirror, vent, or desired area. 3. Ensure it does not come into direct contact with any plastic, vinyl, or painted surfaces to prevent damage.

name: Air freshener misty assorted
specs: ABRO Misty Air Freshener Assorted (SM-557) is a convenient fine-mist aerosol spray designed to immediately eliminate stubborn odors and freshen the indoor air with a variety of pleasant fragrances.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well before each use. 2. Hold the can upright and spray toward the center of the room in a sweeping motion. 3. Avoid spraying directly onto delicate fabrics, leather, or varnished surfaces.

name: Aluminum Foil Tape 2  x 40yd
specs: ABRO Aluminum Foil Tape 2" x 40yd (2290-2INCH) is a high-strength aluminum foil tape coated with a cold-weather acrylic adhesive. It offers excellent heat and light reflection, vapor barrier protection, and conformability.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry the surface thoroughly to remove any dirt, oil, or grease. 2. Peel back a portion of the release liner. 3. Apply the tape to the joint, pressing firmly from the center outward to eliminate air bubbles and ensure a secure seal.

name: Aluminum Foil Tape 3  x 40yd
specs: ABRO Aluminum Foil Tape 3" x 40yd (2290-3INCH) is a wider, professional-grade aluminum foil tape designed for heavy-duty sealing of ductwork, HVAC insulation, and vapor barriers, offering excellent moisture and temperature resistance.
usageInstructions: 1. Prepare the surface by cleaning and drying. 2. Align the tape over the seam or joint. 3. Slowly peel off the backing liner while pressing the tape down firmly with a squeegee or plastic tool to maximize adhesion.

name: Anti-rain clear view
specs: ABRO Anti-Rain Clear View (AR-180) is a liquid glass treatment that chemically bonds to exterior glass to repel rain, sleet, and snow. It dramatically improves wet-weather driving visibility and makes it easier to remove ice and insects.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry the glass surface thoroughly. 2. Apply a small amount of product to a clean microfiber cloth or paper towel. 3. Wipe onto the exterior glass in a circular, overlapping motion. 4. Allow to dry to a slight haze, then buff off with a dry, clean cloth until crystal clear.

name: Auto silicon spray - strawberry
specs: ABRO Auto Silicone Spray Strawberry (AS-300-ST) is a premium silicone-based aerosol lubricant and protectant infused with a pleasant strawberry scent. It prevents sticking, locks out moisture, and protects rubber, plastic, and metal parts.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray a thin, even coat onto the target surface from a distance of 8-10 inches. 3. Wipe off any overspray from adjacent painted or glass surfaces immediately with a clean, dry cloth.

name: Auto silicone spray - lemon
specs: ABRO Auto Silicone Spray Lemon (AS-300-LE) is an effective silicone-based lubricant and beautifier that conditions rubber seals, hinges, and plastic trims, featuring a refreshing lemon fragrance.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the target area is clean. 2. Spray directly onto the mechanism, rubber strip, or plastic piece. 3. For precise applications, spray onto a clean microfiber cloth and rub the product onto the surface manually.

name: Auto silicone spray - waterfall
specs: ABRO Auto Silicone Spray Waterfall (AS-300-WA) is a high-grade silicone lubricant designed to eliminate squeaks and protect automotive interior and exterior components, leaving a crisp waterfall scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake well before spraying. 2. Hold the can upright and apply a light mist to sliding tracks, weather stripping, or pulleys. 3. Allow to dry or buff off excess with a microfiber towel.

name: Automatic  transmission fluid Dexron iii
specs: ABRO Automatic Transmission Fluid Dexron III (AT-170D-III-QT) is a high-performance fluid designed for automatic transmissions requiring Dexron III, Mercon, or Allison C-4 performance levels. It offers excellent thermal stability and anti-wear protection.
usageInstructions: 1. Refer to your vehicle owner's manual for specific filling instructions and fluid level check procedures. 2. Add the fluid slowly to the transmission dipstick tube or reservoir using a clean funnel. 3. Do not overfill, and recheck the fluid level when the engine is warm.

name: Automatic transmission fluid premium
specs: ABRO Premium Automatic Transmission Fluid (AT-160-QT) is a premium-grade transmission fluid formulated with highly refined base oils and select additives to provide smooth shifting and wear protection in a wide variety of passenger cars.
usageInstructions: 1. Locate the transmission dipstick with the engine running at operating temperature. 2. Check the current fluid level. 3. Using a clean funnel, add fluid in small increments, checking the dipstick frequently until the correct level is reached.

name: Battery terminal cleaner
specs: ABRO Battery Terminal Cleaner (BC-575) is an aerosol spray that instantly neutralizes acid and removes corrosion, dirt, and grease from battery terminals, cables, and hold-down brackets, restoring electrical flow.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray the product generously onto the corroded terminals and cable connectors. 3. Allow the foam to penetrate for 3-5 minutes, scrubbing heavy deposits with a wire brush. 4. Rinse off with water and dry thoroughly before reconnecting.

name: Battery terminal protector
specs: ABRO Battery Terminal Protector (BP-675) is a heavy-duty aerosol spray that deposits a durable protective coating over clean battery terminals to prevent future acid corrosion, moisture penetration, and voltage leakage.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure battery terminals are completely clean and dry. 2. Shake the can well. 3. Spray an even layer directly onto the assembled battery terminals, clamps, and cables. 4. Allow the protective film to dry completely before operating the vehicle.

name: Belt dressing  and conditioner
specs: ABRO Belt Dressing and Conditioner (BD-100) is a specialized spray designed to eliminate squeaks, stop slippage, and restore flexibility to rubber drive belts (V-belts, flat belts, and serpentine belts), extending their service life.
usageInstructions: 1. Turn off the engine. 2. Shake the can well. 3. Spray a light, even coat onto the inner pulling surface of the belt while keeping the nozzle 8-10 inches away. 4. Start the engine and run for a few minutes to distribute the product evenly.

name: Brake & brake parts cleaner non-chlated
specs: ABRO Non-Chlorinated Brake & Brake Parts Cleaner (BC-750) is a fast-drying, ultra-strong solvent designed to blast away brake fluid, grease, oil, and road grime from brake calipers, rotors, drums, and pads without leaving a residue.
usageInstructions: 1. Protect surrounding rubber and plastic parts from overspray. 2. Spray the product generously onto the brake components from a distance of 12-18 inches. 3. Allow the contaminated fluid to drain into an approved container. 4. Air dry or wipe clean with a lint-free cloth.

name: Brake cleaner
specs: ABRO Brake Cleaner (BD-780) is a heavy-duty aerosol brake parts cleaner that quickly penetrates and dissolves oil, grease, and brake dust, ensuring quiet, reliable brake performance.
usageInstructions: 1. Point the nozzle at the area to be cleaned. 2. Spray in short bursts to rinse away surface contaminants. 3. Use a wire brush for heavily encrusted grease if necessary. 4. Wipe off excess fluid or allow to dry completely before reassembly.

name: Bug & tar remover
specs: ABRO Bug & Tar Remover (BT-422) is a highly effective, clear-coat safe spray that penetrates and breaks down bugs, road tar, tree sap, and asphalt from car exteriors, chrome, and headlights.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash and dry the vehicle before application. 2. Spray the product directly onto the affected area and let it penetrate for 30-60 seconds. 3. Wipe off gently with a soft microfiber cloth, turning it frequently. 4. Rinse the area with clean water.

name: Car wax siliconised
specs: ABRO Siliconised Car Wax (SW-300) is an easy-to-use liquid car wax that combines pure carnauba wax with silicone polymers to provide a long-lasting, deep mirror shine and water-beading protection.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash the vehicle and dry it thoroughly. 2. Shake the bottle well. 3. Apply a small amount to a clean, damp applicator pad and rub onto the paint in a circular, overlapping pattern. 4. Allow to dry to a haze, then buff off with a clean microfiber towel.

name: Car wax super gold liquid
specs: ABRO Super Gold Liquid Car Wax (LW-811) is a professional-grade liquid wax formulated with premium carnauba wax and advanced polymers to deliver unmatched depth of color, brilliant shine, and durable protection against UV rays.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash and dry the vehicle. 2. Shake bottle thoroughly. 3. Apply a small amount of wax onto a soft cloth or foam applicator and spread evenly over one section at a time. 4. Let the wax dry to a light haze, then buff to a deep shine with a microfiber towel.

name: Car Wax Super Gold Paste 234gm
specs: ABRO Super Gold Paste Car Wax 234g (PW-400) is a high-performance paste wax made with pure, hard carnauba wax. It provides maximum paint protection, deep reflectivity, and water-beading endurance for up to several months.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry the car surface. 2. Apply a thin, even coat of paste wax using the included applicator pad. 3. Allow the wax to dry to a white, dry haze (usually 5-10 minutes). 4. Buff off the residue using a clean, soft microfiber towel.

name: Carb & choke cleaner (20% more)
specs: ABRO Carb & Choke Cleaner 20% More (CC-220) is a high-powered solvent spray designed to remove varnish, sludge, gum, carbon deposits, and dirt from carburetors, choke linkages, PCV valves, and manifold heat controls.
usageInstructions: 1. Remove the air filter with the engine off. 2. Spray onto the exterior carburetor linkages and throttle body. 3. Start the engine and spray in short bursts down the carburetor throat to clean internal components, keeping the engine idling until clean. 4. Reinstall the air filter.

name: Carb & Choke Cleaner (small)
specs: ABRO Carb & Choke Cleaner Small (CC-200) is a compact, highly pressurized spray that dissolves carbon, gum, and varnish deposits inside and outside carburetors and automatic chokes, restoring engine efficiency.
usageInstructions: 1. Turn off the engine. 2. Spray the cleaner directly onto carburetor linkages, chokes, and vacuum ports. 3. If treating the carburetor interior, spray directly into the throat while keeping the engine revved lightly. 4. Let any excess solvent evaporate before restarting.

name: Car body Filler - 1 kg.
specs: ABRO Car Body Filler 1kg (P.49LW-QT) is a lightweight, easy-sanding polyester putty used for filling dents, scratches, and minor holes in steel, aluminum, wood, and fiberglass vehicle panels.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean, sand, and degrease the repair area. 2. Mix 100 parts of body filler with 2 parts of the included cream hardener on a clean mixing board. 3. Apply the mixture immediately to the repair area using a plastic spreader. 4. Allow 20-30 minutes to cure, then sand with coarse and fine sandpaper until flush.

name: Car body Filler - 4 kg.
specs: ABRO Car Body Filler 4kg (P.49LW-GL) is a large-format, professional-grade lightweight body filler ideal for collision centers and large automotive body repair projects. It offers smooth spreading and non-sagging properties.
usageInstructions: 1. Prep the surface by sanding back to bare metal. 2. Mix the required amount of filler with the appropriate proportion of hardener. 3. Spread smoothly over the dented area. 4. Let it cure fully before sanding, priming, and painting.

name: Caulking gun
specs: ABRO Caulking Gun (CG-302) is a standard, durable steel caulking gun designed for smooth extrusion of sealants, adhesives, and silicone cartridges up to 310ml.
usageInstructions: 1. Press the rear release trigger and pull the plunger rod all the way back. 2. Insert the sealant or adhesive cartridge into the gun frame. 3. Cut the cartridge tip, puncture the inner seal, and squeeze the trigger repeatedly to dispense.

name: Caulking gun premium
specs: ABRO Premium Caulking Gun (CG-305) is a professional, high-thrust ratio caulking gun featuring a heavy-duty steel body, non-drip mechanism, and ergonomic handle for effortless extrusion of high-viscosity materials.
usageInstructions: 1. Insert the adhesive/sealant cartridge into the metal cradle. 2. Cut the plastic nozzle at a suitable angle. 3. Gently squeeze the handle to pump the plunger against the cartridge bottom, ensuring a steady, smooth flow.

name: Chain lube
specs: ABRO Chain Lube (CL-100) is a high-performance foaming aerosol lubricant designed specifically for motorcycle, bicycle, and ATV drive chains. It penetrates deep into chain rollers and links, then cures to a tacky, sling-resistant coating.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the chain thoroughly to remove dirt and old lube. 2. Shake the can well. 3. Spray directly onto the inner side of the chain while manually rotating the wheel. 4. Allow 10-15 minutes for the lubricant to penetrate and set before riding.

name: Chamois Cloth Large
specs: ABRO Chamois Cloth Large (CH-338) is a premium, highly absorbent synthetic chamois cloth designed for quick, streak-free drying of painted, glass, and chrome vehicle surfaces without scratching.
usageInstructions: 1. Wet the chamois in clean water and wring it out before first use. 2. Pull the chamois flat across the wet surface of the vehicle. 3. Wring out excess water as it becomes saturated, and repeat until the vehicle is dry.

name: Chamois Cloth Small
specs: ABRO Chamois Cloth Small (CH-330) is a compact, highly absorbent synthetic drying cloth ideal for drying mirrors, motorcycles, interior glass, and tight corners without leaving lint or water spots.
usageInstructions: 1. Dampen the cloth with water and squeeze out any excess. 2. Wipe down wet surfaces in straight strokes. 3. Rinse with clean water and squeeze dry periodically during use. 4. Store damp in its original tube to prevent hardening.

name: Clean all
specs: ABRO Clean All (FC-577) is a concentrated multi-purpose spray cleaner formulated to dissolve tough stains, grease, and grime on carpets, upholstery, vinyl, plastic, and home appliances.
usageInstructions: 1. Spray directly onto the dirty surface. 2. Allow the cleaner to penetrate for 1-2 minutes. 3. Wipe clean with a soft cloth or scrub gently with a soft brush for heavy soil. 4. Rinse or wipe off with a damp cloth if needed.

name: Clean all foam lime scent
specs: ABRO Clean All Foam Lime Scent (FC-650) is a foaming aerosol multi-purpose cleaner that lifts dirt and deep-cleans upholstery, fabric, vinyl, and plastic surfaces, leaving a pleasant lime fragrance.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray the foam generously over the surface to be cleaned. 3. Let the foam penetrate for 30-40 seconds. 4. Rub with a damp cloth, sponge, or soft brush, then wipe dry with a clean microfiber towel.

name: C.v joint grease
specs: ABRO C.V. Joint Grease (CV-503) is a lithium-based grease fortified with molybdenum disulfide, designed specifically to withstand the extreme pressure, high loads, and temperatures found in constant velocity joints.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the CV joint assembly thoroughly of all old grease and contaminants. 2. Pack the grease firmly into the joint and boot. 3. Reassemble the boot and clamp securely to prevent grease leakage or water entry.

name: Dashboard polish cherry
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Cherry (DP-523-CH) is a high-gloss spray protectant designed to restore, shine, and shield vehicle dashboards, door panels, and vinyl trim from UV damage, leaving a sweet cherry aroma.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray lightly and evenly onto the surface from 8 inches away. 3. Buff immediately with a clean, soft cloth to achieve a rich, protective shine. Do not use on steering wheels or pedals.

name: Dashboard polish lemon
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Lemon (DP-523-LE) is an aerosol vinyl and plastic protectant that cleans, shines, and prevents fading, cracking, and hardening of dashboards, accented with a fresh lemon scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Spray onto a soft cloth or directly onto the dashboard. 2. Wipe over the area to ensure even coverage. 3. Buff with a clean microfiber cloth to a brilliant finish.

name: Dashboard polish lemon
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Lemon 600ml (DP-633-LE) is a large-format dashboard and interior trim protectant that provides anti-static protection against dust accumulation while infusing the cabin with a lemon scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake can. 2. Apply a light mist over the dashboard and vinyl panels. 3. Wipe and spread the polish using a dry microfiber cloth, buffing until a non-greasy, high-gloss shine is achieved.

name: Dashboard polish lilac
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Lilac (DP-633-LI) is a high-performance vinyl, plastic, and rubber protectant spray that guards against aging and cracking, leaving a pleasant lilac scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the surface is dry and free of loose dust. 2. Spray onto the target area or onto a soft sponge. 3. Spread evenly and buff off any excess with a clean cloth.

name: Dashboard polish m/strawberry
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Strawberry (DP-633-ST) is a premium aerosol dashboard restorer that conditions interior plastics, leatherette, and vinyl, featuring a sweet strawberry fragrance.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the container. 2. Apply the spray directly to the dashboard, avoiding glass surfaces. 3. Wipe off immediately with a clean microfiber cloth to reveal a protective, glossy shield.

name: Dashboard polish strawberry
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Strawberry (DP-523-ST) is a compact, highly effective aerosol spray that protects car interior plastics and vinyl trims from drying out under direct sunlight, leaving a strawberry aroma.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake can well. 2. Hold can 8 inches from the dashboard and spray lightly. 3. Buff with a soft, clean cloth to a dry, glossy shine.

name: Dashboard polish vanilla
specs: ABRO Dashboard Polish Vanilla (DP-523-VA) is a protective spray for car dashboards, rubber, and plastic moldings, providing a rich glossy shine and a warm, inviting vanilla scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray onto a microfiber cloth or directly onto the surface. 3. Wipe evenly across the dashboard and buff dry to prevent streak marks.

name: Decorative spray paint crackle base coat
specs: ABRO Decorative Spray Paint Crackle Base Coat (DP-BC-100WH) is a specialized white base coat designed for creating a unique crackle effect when combined with a matching crackle top coat.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and sand the object's surface. 2. Shake the can vigorously for 1-2 minutes. 3. Apply 2-3 thin, even coats of the base coat and allow to dry thoroughly (approx. 24 hours) before applying the crackle top coat.

name: Decorative spray paint crackle top coat
specs: ABRO Decorative Spray Paint Crackle Top Coat Blue (DP-TC-200BL) is a fast-acting top coat that cracks as it dries over the crackle base coat, revealing a spectacular distressed, crackled paint design.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the base coat is completely dry. 2. Shake the top coat can well. 3. Spray a single, medium-to-heavy coat over the base coat. The crackle effect will begin appearing as the paint dries. 4. Seal with a clear coat after 24 hours.

name: Decorative spray paint stone premium
specs: ABRO Decorative Spray Paint Stone Premium (DP-ST-300CS) is a premium textured aerosol paint that mimics the look and feel of real stone. It provides a multi-colored, highly durable finish on wood, metal, plastic, and clay.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean, sand, and prime the surface if necessary. 2. Shake the can for 2 minutes. 3. Spray from a distance of 12-16 inches in light, sweeping coats, allowing 15 minutes between coats until desired texture is achieved.

name: Diesel fuel treatment
specs: ABRO Diesel Fuel Treatment (DT-508) is a concentrated additive formulated to disperse water, prevent fuel line freeze-ups, reduce emissions, clean injectors, and prevent rust and corrosion in diesel engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Add the entire contents of the bottle directly to the diesel fuel tank. 2. One bottle treats up to 20 gallons (75 liters) of diesel fuel. 3. For best results, use at every fill-up.

name: Diesel injector cleaner
specs: ABRO Diesel Injector Cleaner (DI-502) is a high-strength fuel additive designed to remove carbon, gum, and varnish deposits from diesel fuel injectors, restoring combustion efficiency and fuel economy.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the entire bottle into the diesel fuel tank before filling with fuel. 2. One bottle treats up to 20 gallons of diesel fuel. 3. Use every 3,000 miles (approx. 5,000 km) to maintain clean injectors.

name: Diesel injector cleaner  946ml
specs: ABRO Diesel Injector Cleaner 946ml (DI-532) is a large-format, professional-strength diesel fuel additive that cleans entire fuel systems, lubricates injectors, and improves cold starts in light-duty and heavy-duty diesel trucks.
usageInstructions: 1. Add the appropriate volume to the main fuel tank. 2. One bottle of 946ml treats up to 100 gallons of diesel fuel. 3. Use regularly to maximize engine performance and minimize black smoke emissions.

name: Diesel system cleaner
specs: ABRO Diesel System Cleaner (DS-900) is an advanced, comprehensive diesel system treatment that cleans fuel injectors, combustion chambers, and valves while improving cetane rating and fuel stability.
usageInstructions: 1. Empty the entire bottle into the diesel tank. 2. Fill the tank with fuel to ensure proper mixing. 3. Run the vehicle normally to clean the fuel injection pump and remove carbon deposits.

name: Disinfectant spray
specs: ABRO Disinfectant Spray (DS-340) is an aerosol surface sanitizer designed to kill 99.9% of germs, bacteria, and viruses on hard and soft surfaces, eliminating odor-causing organisms.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Hold the can 6-8 inches from the surface. 3. Spray until the surface is wet. 4. Allow to air dry for 10 minutes to ensure full disinfection before touching or wiping.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Black
specs: ABRO Black Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-BLK) is a heavy-duty, polyethylene-coated cloth tape with a high-tack rubber adhesive. It is water-resistant, conformable, and tears easily by hand.
usageInstructions: 1. Thoroughly clean and dry the surface. 2. Tear or cut the required length of duct tape. 3. Apply the tape to the repair or bundle, pressing firmly down to seal and secure.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Blue
specs: ABRO Blue Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-BLU) is a high-visibility, versatile colored duct tape ideal for temporary repairs, bundling, color coding, and sealing.
usageInstructions: 1. Prep the target area to remove dust and oil. 2. Unroll the desired length and tear manually. 3. Press onto the surface firmly, smoothing out any wrinkles for maximum grip.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Burgundy
specs: ABRO Burgundy Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-BURGNDY) is a decorative and industrial-strength colored duct tape that provides excellent adhesion and waterproof protection.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the bonding surface. 2. Apply the tape over the joint or tear. 3. Smooth down firmly with fingers to ensure strong, long-lasting adhesion.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Orange
specs: ABRO Orange Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-ORNGE) is a bright, high-visibility colored duct tape designed for marking hazards, color-coding wires, bundling, and reliable general repairs.
usageInstructions: 1. Make sure the surface is free of grease and dust. 2. Stick the tape onto the target area. 3. Rub firmly across the tape backing to activate the pressure-sensitive adhesive.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Red
specs: ABRO Red Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-RED) is a strong, multi-purpose red-colored duct tape featuring a waterproof backing and high-tack adhesive, suitable for indoor and outdoor applications.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the surface. 2. Tear off the desired length. 3. Firmly apply the tape, starting from one edge and smoothing to the other to avoid trapping air.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Silver
specs: ABRO Silver Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-SILVER) is a classic silver-colored duct tape with extreme adhesive strength, perfect for general maintenance, pipe sealing, and quick packaging.
usageInstructions: 1. Remove dirt and moisture from the target area. 2. Pull the required length of tape and apply pressure across the entire surface to bond.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - White
specs: ABRO White Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-WHITE) is a clean, white-colored duct tape offering a strong grip, waterproof barrier, and clean finish for home and industrial repair work.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure surface is clean and dry. 2. Apply tape directly over the joint or tear. 3. Rub firmly with your hand to secure the bond.

name: Duct Tape 2  x 9m - Yellow
specs: ABRO Yellow Duct Tape 2" x 9m (6620-YELLOW) is a high-visibility yellow duct tape excellent for warning signs, color-coding, bundling, and temporary patching.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the bonding surface. 2. Place the tape onto the clean area and rub down to activate the strong rubber adhesive.

name: Duct Tape Grey - 2  x 40yd
specs: ABRO Grey Duct Tape 2" x 40yd (MT-395) is an industrial-strength, extra-long roll of heavy-duty duct tape designed for professional HVAC sealing, construction, and long-term repairs.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the application area thoroughly. 2. Measure and cut or tear the tape. 3. Apply with firm pressure along the seams of air ducts or pipes.

name: Duct Tape Grey - 3  x 40 yd
specs: ABRO Grey Duct Tape 3" x 40yd (MTD-395-3INCH) is a wide, professional-grade duct tape designed to cover large joints and seams in commercial construction and heavy manufacturing.
usageInstructions: 1. Prep the surface. 2. Lay down the wide tape over the seam, centering it. 3. Use a plastic scraper or clean cloth to smooth down the tape and maximize contact surface.

name: Electrical Tape 19mmx10yrds Green
specs: ABRO Green Electrical Tape 19mm x 10yds (ET-912) is a professional vinyl electrical tape that is flame retardant, weather resistant, and offers electrical insulation up to 600V.

name: Electrical Tape 19mmx10yrds Red
specs: ABRO Red Electrical Tape 19mm x 10yds (ET-912R) is a high-quality, flame-retardant vinyl electrical insulating tape used for phase identification, color-coding, and general insulation.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure the power is disconnected. 2. Start wrapping 1 inch before the splice. 3. Wrap tightly with overlapping layers and finish 1 inch beyond the splice, cutting the tape with scissors instead of pulling to avoid stretching the ends.

name: Electronic contact  cleaner
specs: ABRO Electronic Contact Cleaner (EC-533) is a fast-acting, high-purity solvent that penetrates instantly to clean sensitive electronic components, switches, and precision instruments without leaving residues.
usageInstructions: 1. Turn off electrical equipment and allow it to cool down. 2. Shake can well. 3. Spray directly onto the contacts or circuit boards. 4. Allow the product to evaporate completely before restoring power.

name: Engine degreaser
specs: ABRO Engine Degreaser (DG-200) is a heavy-duty solvent-based degreaser designed to dissolve oil, grease, road grime, and dirt from car, truck, and marine engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Warm up the engine slightly, then turn it off. 2. Cover critical electronic parts, air intake, and distributor with plastic wrap. 3. Spray the product generously over the engine surfaces. 4. Let it soak for 10-15 minutes, then rinse off thoroughly with a strong stream of water.

name: Engine oil stop leak
specs: ABRO Engine Oil Stop Leak (EO-414) is a premium additive formulated to rejuvenate dry, hardened, and shrunken rubber engine seals and gaskets to stop oil leaks and prevent future leaks.
usageInstructions: 1. Add one bottle of Engine Oil Stop Leak to the engine crankcase. 2. Make sure not to overfill the oil level. 3. Run or drive the vehicle normally. Leaks should stop within 3 to 5 days of normal driving.

name: Epoxy clear 1/2 oz. Kwik-set
specs: ABRO Kwik-Set Epoxy Clear 1/2 oz (EC-510) is a fast-curing, two-part clear epoxy adhesive that sets in 4-6 minutes, bonding wood, metal, glass, ceramics, and most plastics.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure surfaces are clean, dry, and sanded. 2. Squeeze equal amounts of Resin and Hardener onto a clean mixing surface. 3. Mix thoroughly. 4. Apply to the repair and join the surfaces immediately. Hold or clamp for 5 minutes.

name: Epoxy clear syringe
specs: ABRO Epoxy Clear Syringe (EP-300) is a convenient, dual-syringe clear epoxy adhesive that dispenses equal portions of resin and hardener automatically. Sets in minutes to a crystal-clear finish.
usageInstructions: 1. Snap off the end cap of the syringe. 2. Depress the plunger to dispense equal parts of both components onto a mixing surface. 3. Mix thoroughly with the included spatula. 4. Apply to the target area. Re-cap the syringe for future use.

name: Epoxy steel adhesive tube
specs: ABRO Epoxy Steel Adhesive Tube (ES-507) is a steel-filled epoxy adhesive in individual squeeze tubes, offering extreme strength and steel-like hardness once cured. Ideal for bonding and repairing iron and steel parts.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and prepare the metal surface. 2. Squeeze equal parts from both tubes and mix thoroughly until a uniform dark gray color is obtained. 3. Apply to the damaged area. 4. Allow 4 hours to cure before machining or drilling.

name: Exhaust system repair tape
specs: ABRO Exhaust System Repair Tape (ER-400) is a heavy-duty, heat-resistant tape designed to seal leaks, holes, and cracks in mufflers, tailpipes, and exhaust pipes.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and scrape the repair area to remove rust and loose material. 2. Wet the tape with water before wrapping. 3. Wrap the tape tightly around the damaged section of the exhaust pipe, overlapping by half the width. 4. Run the engine for 15-20 minutes to heat-cure the tape.

name: Exhaust System Sealer cement
specs: ABRO Exhaust System Sealer Cement (ES-332) is a specialized paste cement that seals holes and leaks in mufflers and exhaust pipes, withstanding temperatures up to 1000 degrees Celsius.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the surface thoroughly of all rust and dirt. 2. Dampen the area with water. 3. Apply the paste directly over the hole or leak using a knife or spatula. 4. Run the engine at low idle for 10-15 minutes to allow the heat to cure and harden the cement.

name: Fire Extinguisher 400ml
specs: ABRO Fire Extinguisher 400ml (FE-935) is a compact, highly portable aerosol fire extinguisher designed for quickly suppressing minor Class A, B, and C fires in vehicles, kitchens, and offices.
usageInstructions: 1. Pull the safety tab or cap. 2. Hold the can upright from a distance of 3-5 feet from the fire. 3. Aim the nozzle at the base of the fire and press the nozzle down, spraying in a sweeping motion until extinguished.

name: Foaming engine degreaser
specs: ABRO Foaming Engine Degreaser (DG-300) is an aerosol foam degreaser that clings to vertical engine surfaces to break down heavy grease, oil, and road grime for easy rinsing.
usageInstructions: 1. With a cool, turned-off engine, cover the air intake, distributor, and electronic modules. 2. Shake the can well and spray the foam generously over the entire engine. 3. Let the foam sit for 10-15 minutes to penetrate. 4. Rinse off with a hose.

name: Foaming insulation sealant
specs: ABRO Foaming Insulation Sealant (AB-703) is an expandable polyurethane foam sealant that fills, insulates, and seals gaps, joints, and cracks against air, moisture, and pests.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can vigorously for 30 seconds. 2. Attach the applicator straw to the valve. 3. Hold the can upside down and fill gaps only up to 50%, as the foam will expand to fill the remaining space. 4. Trim cured excess foam with a knife after 2 hours.

name: Fuel injector cleaner
specs: ABRO Fuel Injector Cleaner (IC-509) is a highly concentrated treatment that cleans clogged fuel injectors, restores spray patterns, improves fuel economy, and reduces exhaust emissions in gasoline engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the entire contents of the bottle into the gasoline tank. 2. One bottle treats up to 20 gallons (75 liters) of gasoline. 3. For optimum performance, repeat treatment every 3,000 miles.

name: Fuel system cleaner
specs: ABRO Fuel System Cleaner (FS-900) is a professional-grade fuel system additive that cleans the entire intake system, including carburetor, injectors, valves, and combustion chambers.
usageInstructions: 1. Wait until your fuel tank is low. 2. Pour the complete bottle into the tank. 3. Fill the tank completely with gasoline. 4. Drive the vehicle normally to complete the cleaning cycle.

name: Furniture polish Lemon
specs: ABRO Furniture Polish Lemon (FP-801) is a premium aerosol furniture polish that cleans, conditions, and protects wood, leather, and plastic, leaving a brilliant shine and fresh lemon scent.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray onto a clean, soft cloth or directly onto the furniture from 8 inches away. 3. Wipe and buff immediately in the direction of the wood grain to prevent streaking.

name: Gasket maker black
specs: ABRO Black Gasket Maker (12-AB) is an RTV silicone gasket maker designed for high-flexibility applications. It resists oil, water, antifreeze, transmission fluid, and temperatures up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry all surfaces. 2. Cut the nozzle to the desired bead size. 3. Apply a continuous 1/16" to 1/8" bead to one surface, encircling all bolt holes. 4. Assemble the parts immediately, tightening bolts finger-tight. 5. Allow to cure for 24 hours before fully tightening and filling fluids.

name: Gasket maker blue
specs: ABRO Blue Gasket Maker (10-AB) is a versatile, sensor-safe RTV silicone gasket maker with high resistance to oil and chemicals, suitable for valve covers, water pumps, and oil pans.
usageInstructions: 1. Thoroughly clean old gasket residue from surfaces. 2. Apply a uniform, continuous bead around the mating surface. 3. Join the surfaces within 10 minutes. 4. Let it cure fully for 24 hours to achieve maximum physical properties.

name: Gasket maker clear
specs: ABRO Clear Gasket Maker (13-AB) is a high-quality RTV clear silicone adhesive and sealant designed to provide a waterproof, flexible seal. It resists aging, weathering, and temperatures up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean, dry, and degrease surfaces. 2. Apply a continuous bead to the surface. 3. Join parts immediately and let cure. 4. Clean any excess wet silicone with a dry paper towel.

name: Gasket maker copper high temp
specs: ABRO Copper Gasket Maker High Temp (418-AB) is a premium RTV silicone gasket maker formulated with copper. It provides maximum temperature resistance up to 700 degrees Fahrenheit, perfect for exhaust manifolds and turbochargers.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean surfaces of any grease, oil, and old gasket residue. 2. Apply a continuous bead to one flange surface. 3. Reassemble parts immediately, hand-tightening bolts. 4. Allow 24 hours to cure before putting the engine back in service.

name: Gasket Maker Grey 1.5oz.(42.5g)
specs: ABRO Gasket Maker Grey 1.5oz (9-AB-42) is a compact tube of sensor-safe grey RTV silicone, designed for heavy-duty, high-vibration applications such as timing gear covers and intake manifolds.
usageInstructions: 1. Surfaces must be clean, dry, and free of grease. 2. Pierce the seal and attach the nozzle. 3. Apply a continuous bead on one surface. 4. Assemble and torque to specs, allowing 24 hours to cure.

name: Gasket Maker Grey 999 Spray
specs: ABRO Gasket Maker Grey 999 Spray (9-AB-8-R) is a sprayable gasket sealant formulated to coat thin paper, felt, or cork gaskets to improve sealing and prevent slippage during assembly.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean both the gasket and the metal surface. 2. Shake the can well. 3. Spray an even coat onto both sides of the gasket from a distance of 6-10 inches. 4. Allow to become tacky, then assemble.

name: Gasket maker grey 999
specs: ABRO Gasket Maker Grey 999 (9-AB) is a high-performance, sensor-safe grey RTV silicone gasket maker designed for high-torque and high-vibration engine applications, resisting temperatures up to 650 degrees Fahrenheit.
usageInstructions: 1. Prep the mating surfaces. 2. Apply a continuous bead of Grey 999 RTV silicone to one flange surface. 3. Bolt components together. 4. Allow to cure for 24 hours before running the engine.

name: Gasket maker red
specs: ABRO Red Gasket Maker (11-AB) is a high-temperature RTV silicone gasket maker designed to withstand temperatures up to 650 degrees Fahrenheit. It is highly resistant to automotive fluids and ideal for exhaust-related applications.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry surfaces. 2. Apply a bead to one surface, looping around bolt holes. 3. Join parts immediately. 4. Leave to cure for 24 hours before filling fluids.

name: Gasket shellac
specs: ABRO Gasket Shellac (GS-10A) is a classic liquid adhesive sealant designed to coat and seal paper, felt, cardboard, and rubber gaskets, ensuring an air-tight, leak-proof seal.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean surfaces thoroughly. 2. Use the applicator brush on the cap to apply a thin, even coat of shellac to both sides of the gasket. 3. Allow to air dry until tacky, then assemble the parts.

name: Gasoline treatment
specs: ABRO Gasoline Treatment (GT-507) is a fuel additive that cleans carburetors and fuel systems, dissolves gum and varnish, prevents fuel line freeze-ups, and reduces exhaust emissions.
usageInstructions: 1. Empty the entire bottle into the gasoline tank before or after filling. 2. One bottle treats up to 20 gallons of fuel. 3. Use regularly with each tank filling.

name: Gear oil treatment
specs: ABRO Gear Oil Treatment (GT-409) is a premium additive formulated to reduce friction, quiet noisy gears, and extend the service life of manual transmissions, differentials, and transfer cases.
usageInstructions: 1. Add one tube of Gear Oil Treatment directly to the gearbox or differential. 2. Ensure total fluid volume does not exceed recommended manufacturer limits. 3. Do not use in automatic transmissions.

name: Glass cleaner 15 oz
specs: ABRO Glass Cleaner 15 oz (GC-290) is an aerosol foaming glass cleaner that quickly removes bug splatter, road film, dirt, and smoke haze without leaving streaks or film.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can. 2. Spray from a distance of 8-12 inches. 3. Wipe off immediately with a clean microfiber cloth or lint-free paper towel, turning the cloth frequently.

name: Glass cleaner 650ml
specs: ABRO Glass Cleaner 650ml (GC-300) is a trigger-spray glass cleaner formulated with an anti-fogging agent. It is safe for tinted windows and leaves mirrors, windshields, and chrome crystal clear.
usageInstructions: 1. Turn the spray nozzle to the 'ON' position. 2. Spray directly onto the glass surface. 3. Wipe off with a clean microfiber cloth, polishing to a streak-free shine.

name: Graphite shower Oil
specs: ABRO Graphite Shower Oil (GO-946) is a high-grade penetrating oil infused with ultra-fine graphite particles. It lubricates, protects against rust, and leaves a dry lubricating film.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can thoroughly. 2. Spray onto the part or assembly. 3. Allow the liquid carrier to dry, leaving a micro-thin layer of graphite lubricant on the surface.

name: Grinding paste
specs: ABRO Grinding Paste (GP-201) is a specialized abrasive paste containing fine and coarse compounds, designed for valve grinding and lapping operations on engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Apply a thin layer of the coarse compound onto the valve seating surface. 2. Grind the valve into the seat using a valve grinding tool. 3. Wipe clean and repeat with the fine compound for a smooth, gas-tight finish.

name: Headlight restoration polish
specs: ABRO Headlight Restoration Polish (HR-237) is a professional-grade micro-abrasive polish designed to remove oxidation, yellowing, and fine scratches from plastic headlights, restoring optical clarity.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash and dry headlights. 2. Apply a small amount of polish onto a clean, dry microfiber cloth. 3. Rub firmly onto the headlight in a circular motion until clear. 4. Wipe away residue with a clean cloth.

name: Insta mix epoxy plastic
specs: ABRO Insta-Mix Epoxy Plastic (EP-380) is a high-strength, two-part epoxy in a syringe with self-mixing nozzles, formulated specifically for structural bonding of rigid and semi-flexible plastics.
usageInstructions: 1. Attach the mixing nozzle to the syringe. 2. Depress the plunger to automatically mix and dispense the adhesive onto the plastic parts. 3. Clamp the parts together for 10-15 minutes. 4. Allow 24 hours for full cure.

name: Insta Mix Epoxy quick set
specs: ABRO Insta-Mix Epoxy Quick Set (EC-360) is a dual-syringe, clear epoxy adhesive that features a mixing nozzle to ensure perfectly mixed epoxy is applied directly to the work surface, setting in 5 minutes.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure surfaces are clean. 2. Put on the mixing nozzle. 3. Squeeze directly onto one of the surfaces to be bonded. 4. Join components and hold for 5 minutes.

name: Leather and Vinyl Cleaner
specs: ABRO Leather and Vinyl Cleaner (LC-472) is a deep-cleaning formula designed to lift dirt, stains, body oils, and grime from leather and vinyl car seats, dashboards, and apparel.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the bottle well. 2. Spray onto the leather or vinyl surface. 3. Scrub gently with a soft-bristled brush or clean sponge. 4. Wipe off the loosened dirt and excess cleaner with a soft microfiber towel.

name: Leather conditioner premium abro
specs: ABRO Premium Leather Conditioner (LC-750) is a premium cream conditioner formulated with natural oils and aloe vera to nourish, soften, and protect leather surfaces from drying, cracking, and UV damage.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean leather surfaces first. 2. Apply a dollop of conditioner onto a clean, soft cloth. 3. Rub into the leather in circular motions. 4. Let it absorb for 5 minutes, then buff gently with a dry microfiber cloth.

name: Leather vinyl cream conditioner
specs: ABRO Leather Vinyl Cream Conditioner (LC-536) is a moisturizing cream that restores flexibility and color depth to leather and vinyl surfaces, leaving a pleasant scent and non-greasy feel.
usageInstructions: 1. Apply a small amount of cream to a dry applicator sponge. 2. Spread the product evenly across the leather or vinyl surface. 3. Allow to penetrate, then buff to a satin finish.

name: Liquid wax premium abro
specs: ABRO Premium Liquid Wax (LW-900) is an advanced liquid polymer and carnauba wax blend that offers maximum water-beading performance, high-definition gloss, and long-lasting paint protection.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash and dry the vehicle. 2. Shake the bottle. 3. Apply a thin layer to a cool paint surface using an applicator pad. 4. Allow to dry to a haze, then buff clean with a microfiber cloth.

name: Lithium grease super heavy duty
specs: ABRO Super Heavy Duty Lithium Grease (GR-303) is a multi-purpose lithium-based grease designed to provide high-level protection against friction, wear, water washout, and extreme loads.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean grease fittings and surfaces. 2. Apply the grease using a standard grease gun or clean spatula. 3. Re-grease components at the manufacturer's recommended intervals.

name: Lithium grease synthetic
specs: ABRO Synthetic Lithium Grease (LG-990) is an advanced synthetic lithium complex grease designed for high-temperature and extreme-speed applications in wheel bearings, chassis, and industrial equipment.
usageInstructions: 1. Remove all old grease from bearings. 2. Pack bearings with the synthetic grease manually or using a bearing packer. 3. Wipe off any excess grease and reassemble.

name: Lithium grease white
specs: ABRO White Lithium Grease (LG-380) is an aerosol spray grease that applies as a thin liquid, penetrates into tight crevices, and cures to a thick, heat-resistant white grease layer that protects against rust.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray directly onto hinges, latches, sliding doors, or cables. 3. Allow the solvents to evaporate, leaving the protective white grease layer behind.

name: Lithium grease-cartridge
specs: ABRO Lithium Grease Cartridge (LG-921) is a standard-sized 14oz multi-purpose lithium grease cartridge designed for easy loading into standard grease guns for automotive and industrial lubrication.
usageInstructions: 1. Unscrew the grease gun head, pull back the plunger. 2. Remove the plastic cap and insert the cartridge. 3. Pull off the metal pull-tab, screw on the gun head, and pump until grease flows.

name: Lithium grease-Dark blue
specs: ABRO Dark Blue Lithium Grease (LG-857) is a tacky, water-resistant lithium complex grease designed for marine, agricultural, and automotive applications operating in wet environments.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the target area to remove dirt and old lubricant. 2. Apply grease generously by hand or with a spatula. 3. Securely seal the grease container after use.

name: Lithium grease-light blue
specs: ABRO Light Blue Lithium Grease (LG-935) is a high-temperature lithium complex grease designed to withstand heavy shock loads and high thermal stress in disc brake wheel bearings.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure bearings are thoroughly cleaned with solvent and dried. 2. Pack the bearing cage with grease, making sure all roller surfaces are covered. 3. Reinstall bearing.

name: Lithium grease-red
specs: ABRO Red Lithium Grease (LG-920) is a premium red-colored lithium complex grease offering exceptional adhesion and load-carrying capacity for heavy construction and agricultural machinery.
usageInstructions: 1. Fill the grease gun or grease reservoir. 2. Apply directly to ball joints, steering linkages, and U-joints through grease nipples.

name: Lube
specs: ABRO Lube (AL-629) is a lightweight penetrant and fluid film lubricant designed for rapid loosening of rusted nuts and bolts and general-purpose light lubrication.
usageInstructions: 1. Spray the product directly onto the rusted thread. 2. Allow 1-2 minutes for the lubricant to work. 3. Loosen the fastener with appropriate hand tools.

name: Metal polish
specs: ABRO Metal Polish (MP-434) is a specialized metal cream polish that restores, cleans, and protects chrome, aluminum, brass, copper, and stainless steel, leaving a high-gloss protective barrier.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake well. 2. Apply a small amount to a clean, soft cloth. 3. Rub onto the metal surface in a circular motion until a dark residue appears. 4. Buff off with a dry, clean microfiber cloth.

name: Micro fiber mitt chenille
specs: ABRO Chenille Microfiber Wash Mitt (MM-280) is a super-soft, premium wash mitt made from dense chenille microfiber caterpillars. It holds high volume of soapy water and safely lifts dirt away from paint.
usageInstructions: 1. Soak the wash mitt in a bucket of car wash soap and water. 2. Gently wipe across wet vehicle panels from top to bottom. 3. Rinse the mitt frequently in a clean-water rinse bucket to release trapped dirt.

name: Micro fiber mitt terry
specs: ABRO Terry Microfiber Wash Mitt (MM-180) is a durable, low-pile microfiber terry wash mitt that provides excellent scrubbing power for removing bug splatters, bird droppings, and stubborn road grime.
usageInstructions: 1. Dip the mitt into a soapy car wash solution. 2. Wash the vehicle in straight, overlapping lines. 3. Machine wash the mitt after use (without fabric softener) and air dry.

name: Motor Flush (15 oz.) 443ml
specs: ABRO Motor Flush 15 oz (MF-390) is a fast-acting chemical flush designed to dissolve engine sludge, gums, and varnish from the crankcase in just 3 minutes prior to an oil change.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure engine oil is at normal operating level. 2. With the engine warm, add the entire bottle to the oil crankcase. 3. Idle the engine for exactly 3 minutes. Do not drive or rev. 4. Immediately drain the oil and change the oil filter.

name: Motor oil 10w -40 1L synthetic blend
specs: ABRO Synthetic Blend Motor Oil 10W-40 1L (MO-10-40-SM-4L) is a premium synthetic blend engine oil formulated to protect gasoline engines from wear, deposits, and thermal breakdown.
usageInstructions: 1. Drain old motor oil and replace oil filter. 2. Pour the new 10W-40 oil directly into the engine oil fill neck. 3. Verify oil level using the engine dipstick.

name: Motor Oil American15w -40 1L lub prem
specs: ABRO American Premium Motor Oil 15W-40 1L (MO-15-40-SL-1L) is a high-grade motor oil formulated to protect high-mileage gasoline and diesel engines from piston deposits, soot, and oil thickening.
usageInstructions: 1. Locate the oil fill cap on the engine. 2. Add oil according to the vehicle manufacturer's specification. 3. Check oil level on dipstick to avoid overfilling.

name: Motor oil American15w-40 4L lub  prem
specs: ABRO American Premium Motor Oil 15W-40 4L (MO-15-40-SL-4L) is a large-format 4-liter bottle of 15W-40 engine oil. It provides excellent shear stability and anti-wear performance for commercial and heavy passenger vehicles.
usageInstructions: 1. Unscrew oil drain plug to remove old oil. 2. Install new filter. 3. Refill the engine with 15W-40 motor oil to the recommended fill line.

name: Motor oil SAE 20w-50 sl/ci4
specs: ABRO Motor Oil SAE 20W-50 SL/CI-4 (MO-20-50-SL-GL) is a high-viscosity multi-grade motor oil designed to provide robust wear protection in high-performance and high-temperature diesel and gasoline engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Perform a routine oil and filter change. 2. Pour the 20W-50 oil into the engine reservoir. 3. Check the dipstick to ensure optimal levels before starting the engine.

name: Motor oil SAE 40 API
specs: ABRO Motor Oil SAE 40 API (MO-40-SA-GL) is a high-quality monograde engine oil formulated to protect older passenger cars, trucks, and farm equipment requiring an SAE 40 lubricant.
usageInstructions: 1. Drain existing old engine oil. 2. Replace oil filter. 3. Fill engine crankcase with SAE 40 oil to the level marked on the dipstick.

name: Motor oil SAE 50  API
specs: ABRO Motor Oil SAE 50 API (MO-50-SA-GL) is a monograde engine oil designed for engines operating under severe, high-temperature conditions requiring an SAE 50 viscosity grade oil.
usageInstructions: 1. Ensure engine is turned off. 2. Unscrew engine oil cap. 3. Pour the SAE 50 oil into the engine block. 4. Re-check level and replace cap.

name: Motor oil treatment - premium
specs: ABRO Premium Motor Oil Treatment (OT-511) is a high-viscosity polymer additive that stops oil burning, reduces engine noise, increases oil pressure, and improves compression in worn engines.
usageInstructions: 1. Bring engine to normal operating temperature. 2. Turn off engine. 3. Add one can of treatment to the crankcase with every oil change. For high-wear engines, use two cans.

name: Motor oil treatment  regular
specs: ABRO Regular Motor Oil Treatment (AB-500) is a cost-effective oil treatment designed to reduce friction, quiet noisy valves and lifters, and reduce exhaust smoke in older vehicles.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the product directly into the engine crankcase while the engine is warm. 2. Make sure the total oil volume does not exceed the manufacturer's capacity. 3. Run the engine for 5-10 minutes.

name: Motor oil two stroke tc-w3
specs: ABRO Two-Stroke TC-W3 Motor Oil (TS-TC-W3-QT) is a premium ashless 2-cycle engine oil designed for high-performance outboard marine engines and watercraft, preventing spark plug fouling and piston scuffing.
usageInstructions: 1. Refer to the engine manufacturer's fuel-to-oil mix ratio (e.g., 50:1). 2. Add the correct amount of TC-W3 oil to a clean gasoline container. 3. Mix thoroughly before pouring into the fuel tank.

name: Motor oil two-stroke regular
specs: ABRO Regular Two-Stroke Motor Oil (TS-250-QT) is a high-quality 2-cycle engine oil designed for air-cooled engines like lawnmowers, chainsaws, and mopeds, ensuring minimal smoke and clean exhaust ports.
usageInstructions: 1. Verify the correct mixing ratio for your 2-stroke equipment. 2. Pour the required amount of oil into gasoline. 3. Shake the container to mix completely, then fill the equipment tank.

name: Octane booster
specs: ABRO Octane Booster (OB-506) is a concentrated additive that boosts gasoline octane ratings, eliminates engine knock and ping, restores lost horsepower, and cleans combustion chambers.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the entire contents of the bottle into the gas tank. 2. One bottle treats up to 15 gallons (57 liters) of gasoline. 3. Add before filling the tank to ensure thorough mixing.

name: Paint remover
specs: ABRO Paint Remover (PR-600) is a highly aggressive aerosol paint stripper that blisters and dissolves oil-based paints, varnishes, enamels, and shellac from metal, wood, and concrete surfaces.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake the can well. 2. Spray a thick, heavy layer over the paint to be removed from a distance of 10-12 inches. 3. Allow 10-15 minutes for the paint to swell and bubble. 4. Scrape off with a putty knife.

name: Polishing compound 10-oz
specs: ABRO Polishing Compound 10-oz (PC-310) is a mild abrasive compound designed to clean paint surfaces, remove fine scratches, minor oxidation, and swirl marks, leaving a smooth, glossy base.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash and dry the vehicle. 2. Apply a small amount of compound to a damp applicator or microfiber pad. 3. Rub in a circular motion on a small area. 4. Wipe off before the compound dries with a clean cloth.

name: Power degreaser
specs: ABRO Power Degreaser (PD-320) is a fast-acting aerosol engine and industrial degreaser formulated to penetrate and break down heavy grease, oil, and tar on contact.
usageInstructions: 1. Spray generously on the greasy part. 2. Let the formula penetrate for 5 minutes. 3. Wipe off with a clean cloth or spray clean with a strong stream of water.

name: Power steering fluid
specs: ABRO Power Steering Fluid (PS-700) is a high-quality fluid formulated with select base oils and inhibitors to protect power steering systems against wear, foam, and oxidation while ensuring smooth steering.
usageInstructions: 1. Check the power steering reservoir level with the engine turned off. 2. Add the fluid until the level reaches the designated fill line. 3. Do not overfill.

name: Premium car wash (16 oz.)
specs: ABRO Premium Car Wash 16 oz (CW-990-16) is a highly concentrated, pH-neutral car wash soap that creates rich, thick suds to lift dirt and road film without stripping wax or polish coatings.
usageInstructions: 1. Mix 1 ounce of product in a 1-gallon bucket of water. 2. Spray the vehicle with water to remove loose dirt. 3. Apply the suds using a clean sponge or wash mitt. 4. Rinse thoroughly and dry with a chamois.

name: Premium car wash (32 oz.)
specs: ABRO Premium Car Wash 32 oz (CW-990-32) is a mid-sized concentrated foaming wash formulated to provide brilliant streak-free cleaning and paint conditioning in passenger cars and trucks.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour 1-2 capfuls of car wash into a clean bucket and fill with a strong stream of water to create thick suds. 2. Wash the car in sections starting from the top. 3. Rinse and dry.

name: Premium car wash (64 oz.)
specs: ABRO Premium Car Wash 64 oz (CW-990) is a large-format concentrated car wash soap designed for professional detailers and fleet owners, delivering deep cleaning and streak-free gloss.
usageInstructions: 1. Dilute the soap in a wash bucket or soap cannon. 2. Thoroughly scrub the vehicle using a microfiber mitt. 3. Hose off completely and dry to prevent water spotting.

name: Protect all - 296ml
specs: ABRO Protect All 296ml (PA-510) is a multi-purpose liquid protectant designed to protect, shine, and restore vinyl, rubber, leather, and plastic interior and exterior surfaces.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the surface first. 2. Apply a small amount of product to a clean cloth or spray directly onto the surface. 3. Spread evenly and let penetrate for a few minutes. 4. Buff off excess with a microfiber towel.

name: Protect all - lemon 296 ml
specs: ABRO Protect All Lemon 296ml (PA-512) is a vinyl, rubber, and plastic restorer and protectant infused with a crisp lemon scent, shielding surfaces from fading and UV damage.
usageInstructions: 1. Apply directly to a sponge or clean microfiber. 2. Wipe over the dashboard, door panels, or tires. 3. Buff dry to a clean, non-greasy luster.

name: Protect all lemon - 120ml

name: Silicon Sealant 85gm - White

name: Thread lock red permanent gel
specs: ABRO Permanent Gel Threadlock Red (TL-671) is a non-drip, high-viscosity gel formula high-strength threadlocker designed for overhead or vertical applications where liquid threadlockers run.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean threads. 2. Squeeze the gel tube and apply a bead to the bolt. 3. Assemble components immediately. 4. Allow 24 hours to cure.

name: Thread lock high strength red permanent
specs: ABRO High Strength Red Permanent Threadlock (TL-571) is an industrial-strength liquid threadlocking adhesive designed for high-vibration assemblies like motor mounts and suspension bolts.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean male and female threads. 2. Apply a drop to the lead threads. 3. Assemble. To disassemble, apply heat up to 500 degrees Fahrenheit and use hand tools.

name: ABRO TEFLON TAPE 0.5 X 10YARDS
specs: ABRO Teflon Tape 0.5" x 10yds (TT-0.5X10YDS) is a premium PTFE thread seal tape designed to seal water, gas, and air pipe threads, providing a leak-proof and lubricated connection.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean the male pipe threads. 2. Wrap the tape tightly around the threads in the direction of the thread spiral, starting from the end of the pipe. 3. Tear the tape and screw the pipes together.

name: ABRO TEFLON TAPE 0.75 X 10YARDS
specs: ABRO Teflon Tape 0.75" x 10yds (TT-0.75X10YDS) is a wider PTFE thread sealing tape ideal for larger commercial and household plumbing pipe connections.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean threads. 2. Wrap the wide tape overlapping the threads. 3. Ensure a tight, snug wrap around the male fitting before screwing into the female socket.

name: Tire shine
specs: ABRO Tire Shine (TS-100) is an easy-to-use aerosol tire dressing that leaves a deep, dark, glossy shine on tire sidewalls while conditioning the rubber to prevent cracking.
usageInstructions: 1. Wash tires clean and let dry. 2. Shake can. 3. Spray onto the tire sidewall in a circular motion, keeping the spray 6 inches away. 4. Allow to dry. Do not wipe.

name: Tire shine wet black extreme - 23 oz
specs: ABRO Tire Shine Wet Black Extreme 23 oz (BX-999) is a premium trigger spray tire dressing formulated with silicone polymers to deliver a wet, high-gloss shine that lasts for weeks.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean and dry tires. 2. Spray the product directly onto the tire sidewall or onto an applicator pad. 3. Wipe evenly across the sidewall. 4. Let dry for 15 minutes before driving.

name: Trim adhesive
specs: ABRO Trim Adhesive (TA-1285) is a high-strength, weather-resistant aerosol adhesive designed to bond vinyl tops, interior headliners, and carpet to metal and wood.
usageInstructions: 1. Surfaces must be clean and dry. 2. Spray a generous coat onto both surfaces. 3. Let dry for 3-5 minutes until tacky. 4. Press the surfaces together firmly, working out any air bubbles.

name: Upholstery fabric painter burgundy
specs: ABRO Upholstery Fabric Painter Burgundy (FP-226B) is a specialized fabric and vinyl aerosol paint designed to restore or change the color of car seats, carpets, headliners, and door panels.
usageInstructions: 1. Thoroughly clean and dry the fabric or vinyl surface. 2. Mask off adjacent areas. 3. Shake can well. 4. Spray light, even coats, keeping the can 12 inches away. 5. Allow to dry between coats.

name: Upholstery fabric painter hunter green
specs: ABRO Upholstery Fabric Painter Hunter Green (FP-226G) is a flexible fabric and vinyl paint that penetrates and recolors fabric fibers without stiffening them.
usageInstructions: 1. Prep surface. 2. Spray a thin coat over the fabric. 3. Use a stiff brush to work paint into high-pile carpets if needed, then let dry.

name: Upholstery fabric painter midnight black
specs: ABRO Upholstery Fabric Painter Midnight Black (FP-226BLK) is a high-opacity fabric paint formulated to restore faded black car interiors and carpets to a deep black color.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean surface of dust and grease. 2. Spray in even, thin coats. 3. Allow 24 hours to cure before sitting on treated upholstery.

name: Upholstery fabric painter navy blue
specs: ABRO Upholstery Fabric Painter Navy Blue (FP-226BLUE) is a durable aerosol paint formulated for vinyl, leather, carpet, and fabric car seats, offering a navy blue finish.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake can. 2. Apply a light mist over the fabric. 3. Build up coverage with multiple light coats to avoid saturation.

name: Upholstery fabric painter saddle brown
specs: ABRO Upholstery Fabric Painter Saddle Brown (FP-226BRWN) is a flexible vinyl and fabric paint that restores leather and vinyl trims to a saddle brown finish.
usageInstructions: 1. Clean surface. 2. Spray evenly from 10 inches. 3. Allow 30 minutes to dry.

name: Vent air freshener strawberry
specs: ABRO Vent Air Freshener Strawberry (VS-90-ST) is a compact clip-on air freshener that mounts directly to car A/C vents, diffusing a sweet strawberry fragrance.
usageInstructions: 1. Remove the protective seal or insert from the capsule. 2. Clip the air freshener onto your vehicle's air vent. 3. Adjust A/C airflow to control fragrance intensity.

name: Vent air freshener vanilla
specs: ABRO Vent Air Freshener Vanilla (VS-90-VA) is a long-lasting car vent clip air freshener that releases a warm vanilla scent when the car fan is active.
usageInstructions: 1. Clip the device onto an A/C vent slat. 2. Turn on the vehicle blower to circulate the vanilla scent throughout the cabin.

name: Vent air freshener new car
specs: ABRO Vent Air Freshener New Car (VS-90-NC) is an active vent clip-on air freshener designed to neutralize bad odors and restore that sought-after new car smell.
usageInstructions: 1. Unpack and clip onto any air conditioning vent in the vehicle. 2. Adjust air speed to modulate the level of fragrance.

name: Vent scent air freshener jasmine
specs: ABRO Vent Scent Air Freshener Jasmine (VS-90-JA) is a premium vent clip-on air freshener featuring a sweet, floral jasmine scent that lasts up to 30 days.
usageInstructions: 1. Secure the clip into the vent louvers. 2. Ensure A/C is functioning to disperse the fresh scent.

name: Wash-n-glo
specs: ABRO Wash-N-Glo (CW-928) is a concentrated liquid car wash and wax formula that cleans dirt and road film while depositing a high-gloss, protective carnauba wax coating.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour 1 ounce of Wash-N-Glo into a clean bucket. 2. Fill the bucket with a strong stream of water. 3. Wash the car with a sponge or wash mitt. 4. Rinse with clean water and dry immediately.

name: Wheel cleaner 32 oz. 946 ml
specs: ABRO Wheel Cleaner 32 oz (WC-160) is a powerful, acid-free trigger spray cleaner formulated to dissolve baked-on brake dust, grease, road grime, and tar from steel, alloy, and chrome rims.
usageInstructions: 1. Spray the cleaner generously onto a cool wheel. 2. Allow the product to work for 1-2 minutes. 3. Agitate with a soft wheel brush for heavy buildup. 4. Rinse thoroughly with a high-pressure stream of water.

name: Wheel protector
specs: ABRO Wheel Protector (WP-237) is an invisible aerosol barrier spray that seals wheel rims, preventing brake dust, road grime, and salt from bonding to the surface, making future cleaning easy.
usageInstructions: 1. Thoroughly clean and dry wheels. 2. Spray a light, even coat over the entire wheel surface. 3. Let dry completely for 1 hour to establish the protective shield.

name: Wind shield washer concentrate
specs: ABRO Windshield Washer Concentrate (WW-515) is a super-concentrated windshield washer fluid that removes bugs, road film, and dirt from vehicle glass.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the entire contents of the bottle into the windshield washer reservoir. 2. Fill the rest of the reservoir with clean water. 3. Operate washers normally.

name: Wind shield washer tablets
specs: ABRO Windshield Washer Tablets (WW-500) are highly efficient effervescent tablets that dissolve in water to create a powerful, non-smear glass cleaner for your windshield washer reservoir.
usageInstructions: 1. Drop 1 tablet directly into the windshield washer reservoir. 2. Fill the reservoir with clean water. 3. Allow 2-3 minutes for the tablet to dissolve before spraying.

name: Wind shield washer cleaner& antifreeze concentrate
specs: ABRO Windshield Washer Cleaner & Antifreeze Concentrate (WW-516) is a dual-action windshield washer fluid concentrate that cleans glass while preventing the washer fluid from freezing in cold winter climates.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour the concentrate into the washer reservoir. 2. Dilute with water according to the temperature chart on the bottle. 3. Test spray to ensure lines are protected.

name: Premium Spray Lubricant 5oz
specs: ABRO Premium Spray Lubricant 5oz (AB-800-5R) is a premium, compact-sized penetrating oil and lubricant that displaces moisture, stops squeaks, and protects metals from rust.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake can. 2. Spray the lubricant directly on target areas. 3. For tight spaces, attach the extension straw.

name: Premium Spray Lubricant 10oz
specs: ABRO Premium Spray Lubricant 10oz (AB-800-10R-P) is an advanced, mid-sized multi-purpose lubricant designed to dissolve rust, lubricate moving parts, and repel moisture from electric components.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake well before use. 2. Spray onto seized or rusted screws, nuts, and bolts. 3. Allow to penetrate before loosening.

name: Abro Platinum Oil Treatment
specs: ABRO Platinum Oil Treatment (OT-611) is an elite, high-performance engine oil additive engineered with advanced synthetic polymers to boost oil viscosity, protect engine components under extreme heat, and reduce friction.
usageInstructions: 1. Pour one bottle of treatment directly into the engine block with every oil change. 2. Keep the engine idling for 5 minutes after adding.

name: Foaming Carburetor Tune-Up & Conditioner
specs: ABRO Foaming Carburetor Tune-Up & Conditioner (CC-300) is a premium foaming cleaner designed to strip varnishes and lacquer from internal throttle bodies and carburetors, maximizing combustion.
usageInstructions: 1. Warm up the engine. 2. Spray foam directly into the carburetor throat with the engine running. 3. Allow the foam to clean internal valves, then rev the engine to clear carbon deposits.

name: Ultra Plus Copper Gasket Spray
specs: ABRO Ultra Plus Copper Gasket Spray (CG-418) is an aerosol adhesive sealant designed to hold heavy-duty head gaskets in place while transferring heat and sealing microscopic flange imperfections.
usageInstructions: 1. Shake well. 2. Spray a uniform coat onto both sides of the gasket. 3. Allow 30 seconds for the tack to develop. 4. Position and install the gasket immediately.
